**🚀 Exciting News: Joining the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!**

I’m thrilled to share that I’ve been invited to join the **CDS Hooks Project Management Committee**—a fantastic opportunity to help shape the future of this powerful standard that I’ve been working with since **2017**!

CDS Hooks has come a long way, enabling seamless clinical decision support integration into EHR workflows, and I’m excited to contribute to its evolution. Whether it’s refining the spec, expanding adoption, or fostering collaboration, I’m ready to help move it forward.

**Are you using CDS Hooks?**
If so, please add your implementation to the [CDS Hooks Availability Wiki](https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability)—it’s a great way to showcase your work and help others learn from your experience!

**Not using it yet?**
I’d love to help! As a freelance consultant, I can assist with implementation, best practices, and integration strategies. Let’s connect and explore how CDS Hooks can enhance your healthcare applications.

Here’s to the next chapter of interoperability and smarter clinical decision support! 🎉 #CDSHooks #HealthTech #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport
